plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress
plan.subtitle: Overview of scholarship scheme applications by district, focusing on pending cases.

panels.title: Total Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Applicants by District
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS applicant_count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Pending Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending'

panels.title: Pending Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top 10 Districts with Pending Applications
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This page provides a snapshot of the scholarship application process across different districts. The total number of applicants is {{p1}}. A significant portion of these applications are currently pending, totaling {{p3}}. The distribution of applicants varies by district, as shown in the 'Applicants by District' chart. The 'Pending Applications by District' chart highlights the districts with the most pending applications, while the table lists the top 10 districts with pending cases, allowing for targeted intervention and support.
